rows.Bloom: White, light pink edges. 50 to 53 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, wrinkled (rugose) foliage.

Height: up to 35" (up to 90cm).
